svg.title: Four posteriors from four priors on identical data
svg.desc: Beta(27, 15), Beta(28, 16), Beta(42, 18) and Beta(30, 30) densities over germination rates, each posterior mean marked with a dashed drop line.
svg.text: The same 26 of 40 seeds, run through four priors
Every curve is the posterior after the same 26 germinations out of 40 seeds. Only the prior changed.
The four posterior means run from 0.5000 to 0.7000, a spread of 0.20 on identical data.
